The saucepan refund is already paid. Its receipt number is **R-H436-0001**, for 19.99 BRL. It is recorded against your order's original payment.

The policy says a receipt records the refund in the shop's test ledger and is not a bank transfer. The shop also gives no date for money to appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout). The refund is still complete once you have a receipt, and the saucepan can't be refunded a second time (refund-policy/v2/remaining).

I've made a refund proposal for the stainless steamer insert only. The amount is **29.90 BRL** (refund-policy/v2/amount). To confirm it, press the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count. After you confirm, a staff member has to approve it before it can be paid (refund-policy/v2/approval).
